ruleSets.routing: The return year is the calendar year in which the K-1's tax period ends; a calendar-year recipient reports it on that year's return (IRS partner's instructions). The register, due dates, and law use the return year. Box-level checks use the box map for the printed form year. A return year after the last shipped rule set gets tax_year_rules_not_published. A printed form year with no shipped box map gets form_year_differs_from_rule_set, and box-level checks are limited to identity, version, and amendment facts. A printed form year that differs from the return year (a short year or a fiscal year) gets form_year_differs_from_tax_year.

coverageNote: The register covers interests the record shows (prior-year K-1s and current entities). It cannot show investments the household made since then; the review asks.
